note: Guards whose covering test does NOT notice the guard's gate being removed. Measured by Scripts/mutation-sweep-guard-tests.py on 2026-09-18 by inserting `return 0` as the first statement of each guard's main() in a throwaway worktree and running its covering tests: these stayed green. Each drives the guard's helper functions and never its entry point, and the one whole-guard assertion most of them carry is `the real tree passes`, which a guard that refuses nothing satisfies. That is the wiring class of defect this repository keeps finding -- a helper defined and never called, a rule guarding three lists while a fourth sat open -- and a test blind to it cannot see a wiring regression in its own guard. Closing an entry means giving the guard a seam and adding one case that drives main() at an input that must fail; check-ax-comparisons-use-labelsets.py and check-registry-metadata-matches-the-release.py were on this list and were closed that way the same day. This list may only SHRINK.

not_swept.check-canon-citations.py: its test is 76s here; the review's deeper cut showed it catching a permissive decision function, and sweeping it doubles the sweep's cost
